info.title: PS5SD
info.description: PS5SD runs stable-diffusion.cpp's sd-server on the PS5. The server is the console, at http://<console>:7860 (or the port that server-args.txt names). One server serves the web UI and four APIs: the AUTOMATIC1111 API (/sdapi/v1), the OpenAI images API (/v1), sd-server's own API with async jobs (/sdcpp/v1) and PS5SD's routes (/ps5sd/v1): the gallery, the job queue, the model library and the downloader. Every route allows any origin (CORS, without credentials). Until the API key is turned on there is no authentication, so keep the console on your own network. A request body is at most 64 MB; uploads have no limit. Send JSON with Content-Type: application/json. Five wrong keys in a row lock a client out for a while (429, code rate_limited, with Retry-After). A POST, PUT or DELETE that carries the key only as the cookie also needs the header X-PS5SD-Request (any value). Every answer of 400 and more has the shape of the Error schema.

put.summary: Upload a file to the console
put.description: The file is the body. It is passed on to ftpsrv as it arrives, written as `<name>.part` and renamed once all of it is there; if the upload breaks off, the `.part` is removed. There is no size limit. Names: `models` takes a `.gguf`, `.safetensors`, `.ckpt` or `.sft` file, optionally in subfolders (`vae/my-vae.safetensors`); `loras` and `embeddings` a model file name, no subfolders; `presets` `<id>.txt`, at most 64 KB; `upscalers` a `.pth`, `.pt`, `.safetensors` or `.gguf` file, no subfolders; `tags` a `.csv` or `.txt` tag file, at most 64 MB.

get.description: A stream of server-sent events (`text/event-stream`): the jobs and their progress as they change. Events: `jobs` (the queued and generating jobs, when the stream opens and whenever the list changes), `progress` (a step is done; at most four a second), `job` (a job ended: `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled`), `model` (the state of the model library, when the stream opens and whenever it changes; not with `job`), and the comment `: ping` every 15 s. The data of each event is JSON; see the schemas `JobsEvent`, `ProgressEvent`, `JobEvent` and `ModelEvent`. A job's images or video are not in the stream: get them with `GET /sdcpp/v1/jobs/{id}` after its `job` event. At most four streams are open at once. The stream ends when the title closes; it stays open during a model switch.

parameters.name: job
parameters.description: Sends only what concerns that job and ends the stream after its `job` event (at once when the job has ended already).

schema.description: Server-sent events. Each has an `event:` name (`jobs`, `progress`, `job`, `model`) and a `data:` line of JSON.

get.summary: Defaults and what the server supports
get.description: The defaults and what the server supports. It lists the `upscalers` (with the built-in `Lanczos`, `Nearest` and `Latent` modes; `image_upscale: true` marks the ones `POST /sdcpp/v1/upscale` can use), `upscale` (true when there is one) and `limits` (`max_batch_count`, `max_repeat`). It needs the model, so it waits during a switch.

200.description: The capabilities. The fields are not pinned down.

401.description: The API key is needed, or it is wrong (code `unauthorized`).

post.description: Queues an image job and answers at once with the job. Poll `GET /sdcpp/v1/jobs/{id}` or read the event stream. Also does hires fix, image to image and inpainting (`init_image`, `mask_image`, `strength`), edit by the prompt (`ref_images`, FLUX.2 Klein) and ControlNet (`control_image`). `batch_count` makes several images in one job, `repeat` runs the same request several times.

basic.description: `Authorization: Basic` with the key as the password and any user name, for A1111 clients.

cookie.name: ps5sd_key
cookie.description: The cookie that `POST /ps5sd/v1/auth/login` sets. A POST, PUT or DELETE with only the cookie also needs the header `X-PS5SD-Request`.

Error.description: The shape of every answer of 400 and more. `message` is for people; `code` is for programs. The codes are: `invalid_request` (400), `unauthorized` (401), `forbidden` (403), `not_found` (404), `model_not_found` (404), `conflict` (409), `switching` (409), `stopping` (409, 503), `in_use` (409), `expired` (410), `payload_too_large` (413), `model_part` (422), `rate_limited` (429), `queue_full` (429), `too_many_streams` (429), `generation_failed` (500), `load_failed` (500), `out_of_memory` (500), `cancelled` (500), `server_error` (500), `bad_gateway` (502), `standby` (503), `timeout` (504), `storage_full` (507). A status without a code of its own gives `http_<status>`. New codes may come. An answer may have more fields next to `error`.

message.example: Not enough memory on the console for this run.

tv_images.description: Show images and prompts on the TV.

tv_api_key.description: Show the API key on the TV.

fan_target.description: The target temperature in degrees C for `manual`.

image_metadata.description: False: the web UI sends `embed_image_metadata: false` with each image.

default_presets.description: `{"<model_file>": "<preset id>"}`: the preset the web UI loads when you press Use on a model.

SettingsUpdate.description: The fields to change. The others stay.

default_presets.description: Merged: a preset id sets one, `""` or `null` drops one.

now.description: `soc_c`, `cpu_c` (degrees C), `watts`, `fan` (0 to 1), `cpu_ghz`, `cpu` (0 to 1) and `job` (0 to 1). A value that was not read is `null`.

seconds.description: A point a second for 120 s, oldest first, by reading.

minutes.description: The mean of each 30 s for an hour, oldest first, by reading.

PresetDefaults.description: The settings of a preset, all as strings. Only these keys are allowed, and a value has no space.

missing.description: Files of the entry that are not on the console.

base.description: Set for a saved preset: the id of the model it is a preset of.

control_net.description: The file name of the preset's `--control-net`, or `""`.

family.description: The network the entry runs, read from its tensor names, e.g. `FLUX.2 Klein 9B`, `SDXL`, `SD 1.5`, `Z-Image`; `""` when nothing can be told.

part.description: Set for a single file that is only a part of a model: `diffusion model`, `text encoder` or `VAE`. `""` otherwise.

defaults.description: The settings that suit the model, all as strings.

loaded.description: The entry the server has ready; `""` while a model loads and in standby.

load_error.description: Set when the last model asked for did not load; cleared by the next switch.

catalog.description: The id of a catalog entry.

JobError.description: Why a job failed. `out_of_memory` when the console ran out of memory, otherwise `generation_failed` with the server's last error.

JobRepeat.description: Shown for a job whose `repeat` is more than 1.

saved.description: The gallery file names so far (the last 50).

result.description: The images, or the video. A video has `b64_json` (base64), `mime_type` (`video/webm` by default), `fps` and `frame_count`. Only the last run of a `repeat` is in it.

preview.description: While the job runs; `pass` says which image is being sampled (1 for the first).

saved.description: The gallery files of a job with `repeat`.

ImgGenRequest.description: The body of `img_gen`. A field that is left out takes the loaded model's default.

seed.description: A negative seed is a random one.

batch_count.description: Images in one job, up to `limits.max_batch_count` (8). Their seeds are `seed`, `seed + 1`, ...

repeat.description: Runs the same request n times, one after the other.

init_image.description: Base64 or a data URL: the start image (image to image).

mask_image.description: Base64 or a data URL. White is painted over, black stays.

strength.description: How much changes with a start image; below 1 only that share of the steps runs.

ref_images.description: Reference images (base64 or data URLs) for edit by the prompt, FLUX.2 Klein.

control_image.description: The ControlNet guide: a base64 PNG or a data URL.

lora.description: The LoRAs to use. A path that is not in `/data/PS5SD/loras` fails the request.

embed_image_metadata.description: False leaves the settings out of the PNG.

temporary.description: Saves the files as `tmp_sd_...`; they are deleted when PS5SD starts, unless kept.

VidGenRequest.description: The `img_gen` fields, plus these. With a model that starts from a picture, `init_image` is the first frame.

Txt2ImgRequest.description: A1111's request. The fields PS5SD documents are listed; others may be accepted.

batch_size.description: Images in one request, up to `limits.max_batch_count`.

lora.description: The LoRAs to use. A path that is not in `/data/PS5SD/loras` fails the request.

mask.description: Base64 mask. White is painted over.
